あらすじ

There is a village with a tradition of offering women to those in power to survive. Unaware of this, a man and his wife fall into a trap and are forced into sexual acts with each other and a young girl inside a cage. The turns his wife and the girl into insatiable sex fiends, engaging them into all sorts of kinky stuff like blowjobs, threesomes, gangbangs, squirting, and piss play. As their sexual desires grow, they become indiscriminate towards any male. While committing those acts, the man is plotting his escape the village and wondering who he’ll take together – his now sex-crazed wife, the girl who only knows pleasure, or maybe someone else entirely.
